messages:
Ellen (docs): Heads-up - found inconsistent examples in Dedicated provisioning: some samples use 'autoscale' while new API prefers 'scalePolicy'. I can standardize but want prod wording for SLA interactions.

ci-bot: Scan result: 5 example files reference legacy 'autoscale'. Report: https://ci.internal/doc-scans/4990012345

Mateo (eng): Thanks. We standardized on scalePolicy in server v2 last quarter. Docs should show v2; include a tiny migration table.

Ellen (docs): Draft migration table (one line each): autoscale.threshold -> scalePolicy.target_utilization_pct; autoscale.cooldown -> scalePolicy.cooldown_seconds; autoscale.min -> scalePolicy.min_instances; autoscale.max -> scalePolicy.max_instances.

Rina (prodops): Also add a short SLA note: when scaling down, pre-warmed instances still count against your reserved pool for 60s to allow graceful drain. Keep it short.

Mateo (eng): Good call. I'll add a sentence to the runtime note: "Scale-down drains connections and preserves logs for 60s; metrics may lag by ~15s."

Ellen (docs): Proposed minimal YAML example for docs/examples/autoscale/minimal.yaml:
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization_pct: 70
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 6
```

Mateo (eng): Fine. Add a CLI apply snippet: `rwctl tenants set-scale --tenant t-prod --file minimal.yaml`.

Ellen (docs): Will open PR with examples updated + migration table + tiny SLA note. PR link when ready.

ci-bot: Reminder configured to re-scan after PR merge.

Rina (prodops): I'll smoke-test on staging after merge. If all good we can flip quickstart examples too.

Ellen (docs): Filing PR now. Thanks all.
